select area.province, area.city, field.name, pest_record.number, environment_record.value temperature, pest_record.update_time date from area, field, pest_record, environment_record
field.area_id = area.id and pest_record.field_id = field.id and pest_record.field_id = environment_record.field_id and pest_record.update_time = environment_record.update_time and environment_record.category = '温度'

and pest_record.update_time = #{date}
